title: Estimating Synthetic Data
summary: A research project (SCAI2024) that trains generative models on tabular and MNIST-derived data and evaluates their privacy/fidelity trade-offs using custom PF metrics. It fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer for data generation and uses SDV/sdmetrics metadata and utility functions to compute quality measures.
